title: 有限整数字母表上的 infinite additive-square-free word
confidence_basis: The seven-alphabet height-at-most-five census and the four-state 2-uniform no-go class were completely enumerated with exact integers and independently replayed by no-import implementations. Exact scope coverage is enforced; seven corruption tests and one numeric tamper fail closed. The infinite problem remains unresolved, and the low solution percentage reflects that.
summary: Certified exact maxima for all seven primitive normalized four-letter alphabets of height at most five, including g({0,1,2,5})=86 and g({0,1,3,5})=88, plus a certified no-go theorem for four-state 2-uniform endomorphism fixed points. The original infinite existence question remains open.
author: Zijian Zeng
affiliation: Institute of Computer Science and Digital Innovation, UCSI University, Kuala Lumpur, 56000, MALAYSIA
